about_the_game:
Tunguska 2: Whitefall is a work-in-progress sequel to top-down survival RPG Tunguska: The Visitation. This new adventure takes you to a new sector of the Exclusion Zone affected by Whitefall - a snow-like substance that swallows energy and bridges the Zone to higher dimensions.

Revisit familiar faces from the First Generation, who have travelled deeper into the Zone searching for a better prospect: extracting artifacts from higher dimensions during Whitefall events in exchange for money, fame, and tickets to "paradise". Will they succeed, and what dark secrets will be revealed?

Planned Features (evolving):

  • Arsenal of manufactured weapons from East and West

  • Arsenal of makeshift weapons that can be customized and upgraded

  • Simple companion system with item-sharing

  • Base management

  • Expanded skills system

  • Expanded survival stats including body heat management

  • Expanded crafting

short_description: Venture deeper into the vast Tunguska Exclusion Zone. Challenge deadlier mutants and heavily-armed Predators. Survive the perils of extreme cold and other-worldly beings. Get ready to embark on a journey searching for dark secrets and a life beyond.
